what_happened: Falsify-first gating produced a machine-checked refutation of the dispatch TARGET itself: the gap-carrying three-coordinate index (q, min c B, min n B, clip (n-c)) is refuted uniformly in B by a four-state object whose step relation makes the countdown's parity observable at the region end (distance c+1). prototype/parity-index-refutation.lean, lake env lean exit 0, no sorry, standard axioms. The refutation is gap-independent: the colliding pair carries equal n and gaps that both saturate the clip.

Route (C) of the pre-landed prototype (bound the carrier instead of indexing it) closed in three short lemmas rather than a parallel research track: a deadline-bounded ladder sub-carrier is finite, ofSlicedStepFinBranch = ofSlicedStep by rfl on a finite carrier (definitional proof irrelevance), so no_finite_width_sat applies and every bounded-deadline ladder model validates Phi.neg. prototype/route-c-finite-width.lean, 77 lines, exit 0. Saved a planned parallel phase.

The dispatch description's TARGET (the gap-carrying three-coordinate index and its factorization lemma) is false: this task's own research refuted it uniformly in B via the countdown-parity observable at the region end, and closed the dispatch's route (C) alternative with a second machine-checked derivation. The plan therefore commits to NO factorization lemma at all; it plans the re-scoped six-coordinate candidate behind a three-part falsification gate, an exhibited threshold/period theorem, and the record amendments that stop the refuted candidate being described as plausible. The dispatch's ORDER OF WORK item (2) (test route C's premise in parallel) is deliberately not planned - research already settled it negatively.

Two compiled prototypes from the research phase (parity-index-refutation.lean at 484 lines, route-c-finite-width.lean at 77) serve as byte-level oracles for the plan's port phase, so eleven of the twelve pinned Challenge signatures are transcribed from already-green code rather than authored speculatively; only the two gate theorems and the two periodicity theorems are new proof obligations.

Phase 1 decision gate: both cheap gates separated on the first compile. Pre-landed compiled oracles (parity-index-refutation.lean, route-c-finite-width.lean) re-compiled at exit 0 before any port, so the fixture reuse was a copy rather than a re-derivation; the only novel proof was consec_mod_ne (11 lines) for the symbolic-modulus obligation omega cannot reach.

Phase 2 attempt (iii-a) confirmed the plan's predicted OUTCOME (no refutation) but refuted its predicted REASON. The plan expected an achievable-window argument positioned by the residue coordinates; the measurement is stronger and simpler: Count false false holds the countdown at 0 through an idle interval of any length while Drift moves the next deadline freely, so every second-region length is reachable from every pending state (second_region_any_length) and the achievable second-region-end tag set is everything, independently of T, P and B. Recorded as the precise reason the window is determined, per the task's own both-outcomes wording; no plan step was skipped or substituted.
